content.text: Repair Ky option merging. Nested user data (especially json fields named headers, hooks, searchParams or context) must remain ordinary data, rather than receiving root-option special handling. Class instances such as a dispatcher must retain identity when supplied through create, extend or request overrides. Preserve the existing semantics for real root headers/hooks/searchParams/context, arrays, plain objects and null-prototype objects. Investigate the public request and factory paths and verify the fix.

content.text:
Implemented the repair in `source/utils/merge.ts`.

- Restricted special handling of `headers`, `hooks`, `searchParams`, and `context` to root options, so identically named nested fields remain ordinary data.
- Restricted recursive merging to arrays and plain objects, including null-prototype objects. Class instances are treated as opaque values and retain identity.
- Confirmed that `create`, `extend`, direct requests, and HTTP-method helpers all use the repaired merge path.

Verification: all 3 visible tests passed, covering root-option merging, factory/request execution with explicit replacement, and null-prototype data merging and validation.

Only the production source file was modified.
